works.title: Natural Language Programming for AI Agents: A Primer on Clear Thinking and Cognitive Amplification
works.description: A technical primer documenting the development and implementation of a complete natural language programming system for AI agents, built on a Mac Studio by a writer with no formal programming background. Covers system foundations, frameworks for email processing and authentication, website infrastructure, and practical implementations of multi-step AI agent processes. The book demonstrates that sophisticated AI systems can be developed on commodity hardware without deep technical training.
works.quote: Documents development and implementation of a complete natural language programming system for AI agents. Built on a ~$4,000 Mac Studio by a writer and domain expert with no formal programming background.
